summary: JTM 3.2/42 has a personal patient encoded by -xu on klayṭənxu. The relative antecedent lani supplies the cursing agents; the Mṣalawu imperative is the governing verb, not a form of lyṭ.
82/59 has the cognate content object al lawṭoṯani ‘those curses’, with the wife as agent. Personal-patient and cognate-content objects fit the existing curse sense without a new construction meaning.
The ecclesiastical context in JTM 3.2/42 alone does not establish a technical religious sense, contact origin or a separate stem. No Detransitive evidence is supplied.
